pages.text: The stone that started it all — tools, armor, and the binding of this very guide.

pages.title: Where It Grows
pages.text: Ruby veins chase heat, forming near lava below y=50 — search ravine floors and lava lakes. The Nether hides veins of its own, and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/mining_dimension)Mining Dimension$() is riddled with them, sometimes as whole blocks of solid ruby.$(p)Our new cross-world veins reach further still: rubies now grow beneath the Twilight Forest and in the Bumblezone's waxen walls.

pages.title: Ruby Gear
pages.text: A full ruby kit — sword, tools, armor — is the intended first step past diamond, and rubies stay common enough to spend freely.$(p)Field tip: follow the lava. The ore literally grows toward it, and one fire resistance potion turns a hazard into a shopping trip.
